subject: english
title: 七下英语同步章节卷 · Units 5–6
label: Units 5–6 Here and Now · Rain or Shine
unit: 七下·Units 5–6 Here and Now / Rain or Shine
source: 人教版七年级下册 Unit 5 Here and Now、Unit 6 Rain or Shine：现在进行时（构成、-ing 拼写、问答）、打电话用语、天气表达（How's the weather? / What's the weather like?）、名词变形容词（sun→sunny）、时差常识。按初一单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem: Look! The children ______ kites in the park.
items.exp: Look! 提示正在发生，用现在进行时；主语 children 是复数，用 are flying。

items.stem:
—What's your mother doing?
—She ______ in the kitchen.
items.exp: 问“正在做什么”，用现在进行时 be＋doing。坑点：只写 cooking 漏了 is。

items.stem:
—What's the weather like in Harbin?
—It's very cold and ______. The children are making snowmen.
items.exp: 孩子们在堆雪人，说明在下雪 snowy。

items.stem: It's raining outside. Take an ______ with you.
items.exp: 下雨了，带把伞。

items.stem:
—Hello, may I speak to Jenny?
—______
items.exp: 打电话时说“我就是”用 This is ... (speaking)，不说 I'm ...。

items.stem: Listen! Someone ______ the piano next door.
items.exp: Listen! 提示正在发生；someone 作主语按单数，用 is playing。

items.stem: The boys are ______ in the river. It's a hot day.
items.exp: swim 是重读闭音节，结尾只有一个辅音字母，要双写 m 再加 -ing。

items.stem:
—Are your parents watching TV?
—No, ______. They're reading in the study.
items.exp: Are ...? 用 be 回答；后面说在看书，用否定 they aren't。

items.stem: It's a ______ day today. Let's go to the beach.
items.exp: 修饰名词 day 用形容词；去海滩说明是晴天 sunny。sun 是名词。

items.stem:
—Hi, Mike. How's it going?
—______
items.exp: How's it going? 是问候“近来怎么样”，回答 Not bad / Great 等。

items.stem: It's 8 p.m. in Beijing, so it's 7 a.m. in New York. Many people there ______ breakfast now.
items.exp: now 提示进行时；主语 people 是复数，用 are having。

items.stem: What about ______ to the museum this afternoon?
items.exp: What about doing sth.? 提建议，about 是介词，后接 -ing。

items.stem:
—What are you doing?
—I'm waiting ______ the bus.
items.exp: wait for sb. / sth. 等候某人或某物。

items.stem: The weather in Kunming is nice. It's warm ______ winter and cool ______ summer.
items.exp: 季节前用 in：in winter、in summer。

items.stem:
—I'm going to the park with my friends. The weather is perfect.
—______
items.exp: 别人要去玩，祝对方玩得开心：Have a good time!

sections.title: A Postcard from Sydney
sections.passage:
Dear Mom and Dad,
I'm having a great time in Sydney with my aunt. It's July now, so it's winter (16). But it's not (17) like winter in Harbin. It's about 15 degrees. Today it's (18), so we can't go to the beach. We are staying at home.
Right now, my aunt is (19) dinner in the kitchen. It smells good! My cousin Lucy is (20) the piano, and her little brother is playing with his toy cars. Uncle Bob is not at home. He is (21) in his office. He often works on weekends.
I'm (22) this postcard to you in the living room. Outside, people are walking in the rain with their (23). Some children are jumping in the water and laughing.
The weather report says it will be (24) tomorrow. Then we can go to the zoo and see the koalas. I miss you (25)!
Love,
Mary

items.exp: 七月在悉尼（南半球）是冬天，写信人就在悉尼，用 here。
大约 15 度，不像哈尔滨的冬天那么冷。
后文说人们在雨中走，今天下雨 rainy，所以去不了海滩。
在厨房、闻起来很香，阿姨在做饭。
play the piano 弹钢琴。
在办公室，且后一句说他周末常工作。
正在写这张明信片：write this postcard。
在雨中走，带着伞。
明天能去动物园，说明天气好：sunny。
miss sb. very much 非常想念某人。

groups.label: A
groups.title: Weather Report for Saturday
groups.passage:
Beijing: Sunny, 2°C to 12°C. A good day for a walk in the park.
Shanghai: Cloudy, 10°C to 16°C.
Guangzhou: Rainy, 18°C to 23°C. Don't forget your umbrella.
Harbin: Snowy, -15°C to -6°C. Wear warm clothes.
Lhasa: Sunny and windy, -3°C to 9°C.

items.stem: Which city is the warmest on Saturday?
What's the weather like in Shanghai?
items.exp: Shanghai: Cloudy。

items.stem: People in ______ need umbrellas on Saturday.
items.exp: 广州下雨，Don't forget your umbrella。

items.stem: What's the lowest temperature in Harbin?
items.exp: Harbin: -15°C to -6°C，最低 -15°C。

items.stem: Which two cities are sunny?
items.exp: Beijing: Sunny；Lhasa: Sunny and windy。

groups.label: B
groups.title: At the Same Moment
groups.passage:
It's 8 o'clock on a Saturday evening in January in Beijing. What are people doing around the world right now?
Li Tao, Beijing: I'm having dinner with my family. My grandma is telling us a funny story. After dinner, I always watch a basketball game on TV.
Sophie, London: It's 12 noon here. I'm at the market with my mother. We're buying fruit and vegetables for lunch. It's cloudy and a little cold.
Ben, New York: It's 7 a.m. here and I'm still in bed! It's Saturday, so I don't have to get up early. My dog is sitting next to me. He wants to go for a walk.
Hana, Sydney: It's 11 p.m. here. I'm reading a book in my bedroom. It's a hot summer night, so the window is open.

items.stem: What is Li Tao doing?
items.exp: I'm having dinner with my family。看球赛是饭后的习惯，不是正在做的事。

items.stem: What time is it in London?
items.exp: Sophie 说 It's 12 noon here。

items.stem: Why is Ben still in bed?
options: Because it's Saturday and he doesn't have to get up early.
items.exp: It's Saturday, so I don't have to get up early。

items.stem: Why is Hana's window open?
options: Because it's a hot summer night.
Because she wants to see the stars.
items.exp: It's a hot summer night, so the window is open。一月在南半球是夏天。

items.stem: Which of the following is TRUE?
options: Ben's dog wants to go for a walk.
items.exp: He wants to go for a walk。Sophie 买的是水果蔬菜；Hana 在看书；伦敦是阴天。

sections.title: A Rainy Sunday
sections.passage:
It's Sunday today. It's (36) (rain) outside, so my family is at home. My father is (37) (read) a newspaper in the living room. My mother (38) (make) dumplings in the kitchen. My little brother and I (39) (do) our homework at the table. Our cat is (40) (sleep) under the sofa.
I like rainy days (41) ______ I can stay at home with my family. The weather report says it will be (42) (sun) tomorrow. Then we can go (43) (hike) in the mountains.
How about you? (44) ______ is the weather in your city today? Is it (45) (wind)?

items.exp: It's raining. 正在下雨，is 后接 -ing。
is 后接 -ing，现在进行时。
空里要补全 be＋doing；make 去 e 加 -ing。
主语 My little brother and I 是复数，用 are doing。
is 后接 -ing。
喜欢雨天的原因是能和家人待在家里。
be 后接形容词，sun→sunny，双写 n 加 -y。
go doing 去做某事：go hiking 去远足。
How is the weather ...? 问天气；What 要说 What's the weather like?
be 后接形容词，wind→windy。

sections.prompt:
现在是星期六上午 10 点。请以“Here and Now”为题写一篇短文，描述此刻：1. 你所在城市的天气；2. 至少三位家人（或朋友）正在做什么；3. 你正在做什么，心情怎样。要求：60 词左右，题目已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
Here and Now
points: 写出至少三人正在做的事
写出自己正在做什么和心情
语言正确（现在进行时 be＋doing、-ing 拼写、天气形容词），书写规范
sections.sample:
Here and Now
It's 10 o'clock on Saturday morning. It's sunny and warm in my city today.
My family is at home. My grandpa is watering the flowers on the balcony. My mother is cleaning the kitchen, and my father is washing the car outside. My little sister is playing with her dog.
I'm sitting in my room and writing this passage. Later I'm going to play badminton with my friends. I'm very happy now!
sections.exp: 写完检查：每个“正在做”都要有 be（am / is / are）；swim→swimming、make→making 这类 -ing 拼写；天气用形容词 sunny、rainy、windy、cloudy、snowy。
